{"draft": "Micron Technology — Q4 fiscal 2026 analyst note
Record quarterly and full-year results capped a year shaped by AI-driven demand and strong operational execution.
Fourth-quarter revenue climbed to $54.23 billion, up from $41.46 billion in the prior quarter and $11.32 billion in the same period last year. GAAP net income reached $37.70 billion, or $32.87 per diluted share, while non-GAAP net income came in at $38.40 billion, or $33.42 per diluted share. Operating cash flow surged to $43.97 billion, compared with $25.39 billion in the prior quarter and $5.73 billion in the same period last year.
For the full year, revenue grew to $133.19 billion from $37.38 billion in the prior year. GAAP net income rose to $84.97 billion, or $74.33 per diluted share, with non-GAAP net income at $86.76 billion, or $75.52 per diluted share.
Cash generation remained exceptionally strong, with investments in capital expenditures, net of $10.77 billion in the quarter and adjusted free cash flow of $33.20 billion. The company ended the year with cash, marketable investments, and restricted cash of $73.48 billion, and declared a quarterly dividend of $0.15 per share.
Outlook: Management said it expects an even stronger fiscal 2027, so investors should watch whether AI-driven demand and operational execution can sustain the momentum behind the record results, alongside the forward-looking guidance discussed by the company."}
